_doc: VLT-GAP-20 (Hardening H3) config. Edit here, not in the validators. Profiles run the frozen pre-extraction routes and the current routes under the GAP-15 deterministic fakes. Counts are exact; wall time is coarse (in-memory fakes, no Postgres). row-db-linked is a perf-only scenario (rows carry data_entity_id) run only for the groups in scenario_groups, so the branches gated on row.data_entity_id are executed.

entity-secret.GET /vault/gas-overview: handler never answers under the replay fakes (same on OLD and NEW; GAP-15 lists it as allowed_shallow); reported, not timed

migration.reason: routes/vault-migration.ts has no frozen pre-extraction original (224 -> 48 lines in GAP-13, no sealed baseline), so there is no OLD side to compare. It is profiled CURRENT-ONLY: the capture pins its query/boundary counts and route list, and the judge flags any drift from that capture. OLD==NEW by construction there, so V2/V4/V5 cannot fire; only V6 (drift) and V1 (captured cell vanished) protect it.
